note.en: Only a small portion of Evanescia's damage scales on [[stat:atk]], thus HP or DEF Main Stats are viable options for better survivability. For maximizing damage, [[stat:atk]] is more recommended. SPD is only recommended for specific rotations.
note.cht: [[stat:atk]]只佔緋英的傷害的一小部分，若有需要提高生存能力可以選擇生命/防禦主詞。若需要極致傷害，[[stat:atk]]可以考慮。速度多數情況不推薦，除非排軸需要。

note.en: Only a small portion of Evanescia's damage scales on [[stat:atk]], thus she can use any Main Stat. For maximizing damage, [[stat:physical-dmg]] is more recommended.
note.cht: 直傷只佔緋英的傷害的一小部分，因此任意主詞條都可以用。若需要極致傷害，可以考慮[[stat:physical-dmg]]
